description: A metabolic disorder characterized by high blood sugar, insulin resistance, and relative lack of insulin.

associations.disease_role: Receptor tyrosine kinase mediating insulin signal transduction; impaired signaling causes insulin resistance.
Nuclear receptor controlling adipocyte differentiation and insulin sensitivity.
Cell surface peptidase that degrades incretin hormones (GLP-1); primary drug target.
Strongest genetic risk locus associated with impaired insulin secretion.

associations.gene_name: Potassium Inwardly Rectifying Channel Subfamily J Member 11
associations.disease_role: Subunit of pancreatic ATP-sensitive potassium channel controlling glucose-stimulated insulin release.
